text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Appreciation Festival 
has arrived. As for Fuji Kiseki—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They were holding a special magic show 
event.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Welcome to Tracen Academy's Fan 
Appreciation Festival!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Are you enjoying this special day with us?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Fans
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, everyone's so full of energy! Thank 
you for having fun with us!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then—let us add just a pinch of spice to 
this delightful time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Today's main event— The ultimate magic 
show is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And now, appearing before us is a giant 
box and a peerless beauty—Hishi Amazon!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A-A peerless beauty!? What are you 
saying... Wait, what are you doing!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For our charming, slightly shy lady, 
she'll be stepping into this big box♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Hishi Ama! How are things 
looking inside the box~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean 'what's going on'?! It's 
pitch black, I have no idea what's 
happening!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, as you can see, she has absolutely 
no prior knowledge! Now, this box 
containing her—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Like this... and like this... Let's just 
do it like this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki pulled out a padlock and 
chain, wrapped them tightly around the 
box, and locked it up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Eep, what was that sound just now!? What 
are you doing!? Hey, Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright! The real thing starts now! I'll 
rescue her within 10 seconds!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"If we can't save them, the two of us will 
chug super spicy hot sauce together!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Hey, just you remember this after 
we're done, Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, whatever will become of this fair 
maiden's fate?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone! Count down together 
with me, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eggged on by Fuji Kiseki, the countdown 
began!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mm? Oh, that's odd. I'm pretty sure if I 
did this here...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You better not mess this up, you hear 
me?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh! Bad, bad, this is bad! What do I 
do?! Okay, if that's how it's gonna be!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she snapped her fingers, the 
surroundings were enveloped in light—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon, the box, and Fuji Kiseki had 
all vanished into thin air...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The magic show ended with great 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm? The secret behind that magic trick?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's easy! I snap my fingers and 
things vanish, that's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I kept at it for a while after that, but 
she merely brushed it off with a cheerful 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon, who was supposed to be 
inside the box, was standing on the stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAHH!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wait, what?! When did—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that was a close one, wasn't it! 
Hishiama, how are you feeling? Doing okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"It's just a little bright, that's all. 
More importantly—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Mmm~!? What just happened!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now that safety has been proven, it's time 
for Bonus Time!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Now, which little pony wants to be 
enchanted by an illusion next?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Relie—... Haaah?! Are you saying you 
tested it out on me?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From there, a long line formed in front 
of Fuji Kiseki's stage—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I seriously have no idea what's 
happening~! Lord Fuji, you're like a 
wizard!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on! When we got in the starting 
gate, he held my hand...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed the Fan Appreciation Festival 
left everyone thoroughly satisfied!
